owner_account_selection.source_of_truth: the current customer project's registered owner_admin Google email; never infer ownership from account order or another project's session
agent_behavior: when an account chooser is visible, select only the exact registered owner_admin email
if the exact account is already active, continue without asking the owner to choose again
if the exact account is absent, use Add another account or Switch account and pause only for password, OTP, or CAPTCHA
after provider authentication, verify the returned email and Google sub resolve to this project's owner_admin before any admin action
never: select the first or default account without an exact match
assume a Codex, ChatGPT, Google Cloud, or Render session belongs to the same person without project ownership evidence
apply the owner account hint to ordinary public member login
owner_account_selection.public_member_login: Every member chooses and verifies their own Google account; owner auto-selection is restricted to the project-owner setup and verification flow.

first_consent_handoff.trigger: Stage 3 purchase or owner-authorized Stage 3 start reaches the first live Google login verification
first_consent_handoff.user_message: 若 Google 顯示選擇帳戶，請點選購買第三階段時登記的管理者 Google 帳號；完成後系統會自動繼續，不需要重新下指令。
first_consent_handoff.maximum_owner_actions: one account click, plus only provider-required password, OTP, or CAPTCHA
must_not: pause for another confirmation between non-secret setup steps
send the owner back to repeat project information
wait silently after opening the provider account chooser
first_consent_handoff.public_member_separation: This owner setup message appears only on flow=owner_setup; ordinary member login keeps the normal member-facing copy.

owner_login_transport.reason: Keep first owner consent on a controllable full-page route and prevent a detached popup from losing the continuation signal.
owner_login_transport.csrf_guard: Require Google's g_csrf_token form value to exactly match its cookie before verifying the credential.
owner_login_transport.ordinary_member_login: same-page redirect uses /api/auth/google/member-callback and never grants owner_admin without server-side membership verification

sequence: record the initiating login page before clicking the Google button
wait for either a controllable popup/page or a provider-native account chooser
reacquire the popup/page immediately when the automation surface exposes it
run exact owner_admin account matching before clicking any account
wait for the popup to close or the initiating page to receive the Google credential
verify /api/me and same-project owner_admin before declaring success
success_gate: Google credential accepted by the deployed backend
owner-only page is accessible and logout clears the session
must_not_mark_complete_on: an account row clicked without backend identity proof
provider_popup_takeover.native_surface_fallback: If the provider intentionally exposes a non-controllable native identity surface, show the exact matched owner account and one-action handoff immediately; never wait silently. Resume automatically after that single owner click.
provider_popup_takeover.timeout_behavior: Return a structured provider_popup_not_controllable or owner_account_not_present result promptly; never remain waiting without a visible next action.

google_button_configuration.expected_effect: Use a full-page Google redirect so embedded and in-app browsers do not silently stall on FedCM or detached popup handling.
google_button_configuration.fedcm_retry_policy: Do not rely on FedCM or a detached popup for ordinary login; use the fixed server callback and never leave a clickable button with no visible result.
google_button_configuration.identity_guard: The backend still verifies the ID token audience and maps Google sub plus verified email to this project's membership before granting owner_admin.

one_time_authorization.scope: the exact customer project, existing OAuth client, and manifest URL additions disclosed for this Stage 3 run
covers: application name and same-account support/contact email
external testing audience and owner test user
customer-project domains, JavaScript origins, and discovered redirect URIs
Google OAuth web client creation or minimal update
Google API User Data Policy checkbox when it is explicitly included in the Stage 3 start disclosure
one_time_authorization.save_behavior: Codex clicks Google Cloud Save automatically after the scoped authorization; the owner is not asked to click the routine Save button.

provider_mutation_state_machine.authorization_gate: Require one action-time confirmation naming the exact customer project, existing OAuth client, and sanitized URL additions before the first persistent provider mutation.
automatic_after_gate: read the current sanitized origins and redirect URIs
compute an add-only exact-value diff against the generated manifest
add only missing values and deduplicate exact normalized entries
click the Google Cloud Save button automatically
wait for an explicit provider save-success message and for pending progress to finish
reload the existing OAuth client and read back the sanitized origins and redirect URIs
compare the read-back state and fingerprint with the manifest
wait for provider propagation, then run deployed login, callback, session, and logout verification
success_evidence: all required origins and redirect URIs read back exactly
provider_mutation_state_machine.failure_behavior: Fail closed with the exact safe error code; do not create another OAuth client, delete old URLs, or rotate a secret to bypass a save/read-back failure.
provider_mutation_state_machine.truth_boundary: A provider save and read-back prove configuration persistence only; LIVE_LOGIN_VERIFIED still requires the deployed Google callback, /api/me, session, protected route, and logout checks.

agent_steps: select or create the Google Cloud project that belongs to this customer project
match the visible Google account exactly to this customer project's registered owner_admin before changing provider configuration
open Google Auth Platform Branding and fill the project application name
fill only existing project homepage, privacy, terms, support, and verified logo fields
keep a public project in external testing mode and add the owner as a test user
open Clients, choose Web application, and fill the project name
add the manifest JavaScript origins and only the redirect URIs required by a discovered runtime callback
request only openid, email, and profile for basic sign-in
after the scoped owner authorization, click Save automatically, wait for provider success, reopen the client, and verify the sanitized provider configuration against this manifest
owner_only_steps: enter Google password, OTP, or solve CAPTCHA
complete domain ownership or Google verification submission not included in the recorded Stage 3 authorization

otp.plain_language_message: 請開啟當初綁定目前服務帳號的驗證器 App，輸入該服務顯示的 6 位數動態碼；若無法使用驗證器，請改用服務提供的備用碼或帳號復原。請勿把驗證碼貼到聊天。
otp.agent_behavior: Keep the authorized browser on the exact OTP page, identify the provider by name, and resume automatically after the owner submits the code without requiring another command.

password.plain_language_message: 請直接在目前供應商的登入頁輸入密碼，不要貼到聊天；登入完成後 Codex 會從原步驟自動續接。

captcha.plain_language_message: 請在目前頁面完成人機驗證；完成後 Codex 會從原步驟自動續接。

credential_preservation: Never delete the OAuth client to repair a secret-handling issue. Preserve the client ID, origins, and login service; rotate only the affected secret when the runtime uses one.
url_update_guard: URL-only maintenance is add-only by default: never delete an existing valid URI, recreate the OAuth client, or create/rotate a client secret merely to apply or repair origins and redirect URIs.
